author: bardic-inspiration
name: Skyveil Glider
summary: A palm-sized glider with membranes of translucent blue that sail between treetops.
description: Skyveil gliders live in colonies high in the canopy, where they trade gossip in chirps pitched too high for most ears. They hoard bright beads and buttons, and a village that is missing its buttons knows where to look.

traits.name: Glide
traits.text: The glider can fly only when it begins its turn at least 10 feet above the ground, and it descends at least 5 feet during the move.

traits.name: Falling Grace
traits.text: The glider takes no damage from falling.
